name: dbvue
description: A lightweight, local-first database workspace for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @dbvue/shared && concurrently -k -n web,server,shared "npm run dev --workspace @dbvue/web" "npm run dev --workspace @dbvue/server" "npm run dev --workspace @dbvue/shared"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @dbvue/shared && npm run build --workspace @dbvue/web && npm run build:ts --workspace @dbvue/server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @dbvue/server
